name: George
text: George reported that the lobby coffee machine stopped mid-brew and shows an unfamiliar error code. Facilities asked him to photograph the display so maintenance can order parts.

name: Peru
text: The second-floor printer jams whenever a duplex job runs, and the display freezes until the front panel is opened. Ms. Peru from accounting reproduced the fault twice and left sample sheets with the technician, who suspects a worn roller.

name: Yanirys
text: The warehouse badge reader at loading dock two has been rejecting valid cards since Monday evening, forcing drivers to sign in on the paper clipboard and slowing every shipment. Security reset the device twice, but the fault returns within an hour, so the vendor asked for a full event log. The case is now escalated on behalf of Yanirys.

name: Di Cerbo
text:
Both east-wing escalators stopped between floors yesterday, stranding staff on the mezzanine for twenty minutes. Building services requested an urgent inspection quote.
Regards,
Di Cerbo

name: Babica
text: Babica cannot log into the lab scheduling portal after the password policy change, and every attempt locks the account for fifteen minutes. The lab manager confirmed the account exists and suggested a ticket so the desk can verify identity and reset credentials properly.

name: Nelsan
text: The conference room projector keeps dropping the HDMI signal every few minutes, which ruins client demonstrations and has already interrupted two sales calls this week. Mr. Nelsan from the audiovisual team borrowed a replacement cable and tested different ports, yet the fault persists, so he now believes the input board itself needs a warranty repair.

name: Rukmon
text: The rooftop HVAC unit vibrates loudly at night and wakes residents on upper floors. The property team logged a noise complaint and scheduled a technician visit for Rukmon.

name: Ferella
text:
Delivery bay three lost power to its electric shutter, so parcels stack up outside whenever the wind picks up. The facilities desk asked for an electrician assessment before Friday stock intake.
Kind regards,
Ferella

name: Alimatou
text: Alimatou noticed the parking gate arm reacts slowly to valid stickers, sometimes closing on vehicles that have not fully passed the sensor line. Because two colleagues reported near misses this month, security extended the opening delay temporarily, but the underlying sensor drift remains, so a certified technician should recalibrate the loop detector before someone damages a mirror.

name: Usée
text: The shared drive disconnects whenever the backup starts, so afternoon edits vanish unless people save locally. Ms. Usée asked the helpdesk to move backups to midnight.

name: Hierzer
text: The kitchen extraction fan trips its breaker daily, and cooking smells linger into the next morning. Housekeeping cleaned the filters, which helped for a week before the fault returned. The building manager wants the motor checked during the next visit by Hierzer.

name: Bernardeta
text:
Since the software update the customer display at till six shows stale totals, which confuses shoppers who already paid and triggers repeated refunds. The store team reproduced the issue with three test baskets, photographed every mismatched receipt, and escalated the case with a request for rollback guidance before the weekend rush.
Sincerely,
Bernardeta

name: Kirupakara
text: Kirupakara called twice about the broken doorbell unit, which buzzes at random hours even when nobody presses it. The electrician will inspect the transformer on Thursday.

name: Gesto
text: The elevator in the annex skips the fourth floor whenever more than six people board, forcing everyone to climb the last flight with boxes. Mr. Gesto reported the pattern after three separate trips, and the maintenance firm now wants a load test.

name: van Bree
text: The archive room dehumidifier failed during the heat wave, and the librarian found buckled spines on two reference shelves the next morning. Recovery specialists froze the worst volumes to stabilize the bindings, while portable units now hold thirty percent humidity. Insurance wants photographs, purchase dates, and a written loss estimate for the claim, prepared overnight by van Bree.

name: Wittstock
text: Ms. Wittstock, the invoice for March consultancy still lists forty hours instead of the agreed twenty-five, so the finance team paused payment pending a corrected version. Could your office resend the document with the updated breakdown and the revised total?

name: Taekwondo
text: We are drafting next term's activity schedule and noticed the gymnastics hall is double-booked on Thursday afternoons. The head coach offered the small studio, but that would split the group. After the office manager explained the clash to Taekwondo, both clubs agreed to share the first hour and rotate equipment between groups so nobody loses a session.

name: Marevci
text: The summer newsletter exceeded its mailing budget by a third, because of the printed inserts nobody reads. Finance proposes digital-only distribution from August, subject to approval by Marevci.

name: Faretti
text:
Attached is the corrected workshop roster with the Thursday slot moved to the morning, as requested during last week's call. Please confirm the room booking covers both projectors, because the demo needs a second screen for the live prototype.
Cheers,
Faretti

name: Alcides
text: Mr. Alcides, following our site visit last Tuesday, the engineering team finished the structural report you requested. The balcony slab shows hairline cracks consistent with age rather than overload, and the drainage channels need clearing before winter. We recommend a follow-up inspection in spring, when the sealant can be renewed under drier conditions. The full report is attached.

name: Aneta
text: The pottery course sold out within an hour, and the waiting list holds thirty names. Aneta suggested a second evening group if the kiln schedule allows.

name: Abdelmoula
text: The supplier switched packaging suppliers without notice, and half the delivered boxes arrive crushed along the seams. The warehouse team repacked what could be saved and documented the damage with photographs. A complaint letter went out this morning, drafted and signed by Abdelmoula.

name: Reguel
text:
Thank you for the detailed notes from the budget review. I updated the forecast with the revised travel figures and the corrected licenses, then shared the workbook with attendees. Two items need answers from finance: the conference deposit and the maintenance contract. Once those land, the file can be locked and archived with the minutes.
Best regards,
Reguel

name: Mukthar
text: Ms. Mukthar, your library card expires next week and two titles are waiting at the front desk. Please collect them before Saturday or the holds return to the shelves.

name: Moinas
text: The volunteer schedule for the food bank has gaps on the early shifts, especially Tuesdays when the delivery van arrives before sunrise. Moinas offered to cover two mornings if someone else handles the inventory computer, so the coordinator is redrawing the rota.

name: Lília Schrutt
text: The translation agency delivered the report in three languages, but the Portuguese version swaps two chapter numbers and repeats a caption from last year. Proofreading caught the errors before printing, and the agency acknowledged the mistakes within an hour and offered a discount. The corrected files arrived this morning and passed a second review by Lília Schrutt.

name: Cassotti
text:
The park run starts at nine on Sunday, and the volunteer tent needs someone for the water table. Bring gloves, because the bins were not emptied.
Best,
Cassotti

name: Aiden
text: Mr. Aiden, the community garden plot assignments are ready at the seed library this week. Bring the receipt from the membership desk, because the volunteers cannot release keys without proof of payment. Plots unclaimed by Sunday will return to the waiting list.

name: Stevo
text: The museum's night event sold out faster than ever, and the guest list stretches past four hundred names. Catering wants final numbers by Wednesday, because the kitchen orders ingredients two days ahead. Stevo, who coordinates the volunteers, has asked everyone to confirm shifts through the scheduling app rather than by email, so the door teams stay balanced.

name: Hocine
text: The printer lease expires in six weeks, and the vendor renewal quote arrived twenty percent above last year. Finance wants two competing quotes before sign-off by Hocine.
